Results.ReviewText:
42 years ago my father bought us our first weber grill as a house warming present that I have used often through out the years.  I had been using our weber gas grill more in past years but recently got the urge to return to charcoal as a flavor alternative for certain grilling and as an additional option to my 18" Weber Smokey Mountain smoker.  My good old kettle weber didn't have the features of the new grills so I decided to pass on my old Weber Kettle on to my daughter and her family.  
I ordered a new Master-Touch 22" Weber and in a few days it arrived while my 7 year old grandson was visiting.  We opened the box and he pulled out the instructions and said it looked like his Lego set instructions (very clear and simple).  We pulled the parts out and to my surprise he started to organize the components to help me put it together.  It went together so easily I think my grandson could have completed it on his own!
The new Weber is amazing.  How they were able to make so many improvements to such a basic solid design is so impressive.  The looks and convenience in operation and cleaning are really appreciated.  The quality is top notch and we love it. I am so happy with this upgrade and my daughter and husband are enjoying our old one.  I wouldn't be surprised if it lasts another 42 years!
Results.Title: Excellent upgrade from our 42 yr old Weber!

Results.ReviewText: I watched a few online videos before unboxing the grill and completing the assembly. From start to finish, it took about 30 to 45 minutes. The Weber Master-Touch 22" grill was my first charcoal grill, and from the first cook of smoked jerked chicken wings to my last cook of sixteen lbs of pork picnic, the Weber Master-Touch Charcoal 22" grill is a pleasure to use. The charcoal baskets help keep the coals in order and match perfectly with the hinged GBS cooking grate. The Gourmet BBQ System has many different add-ons. I'm considering the waffle iron. The Master-Touch holds ample fuel to cook for six to eight hours comfortably. The most helpful feature of the grill is the large ash basket. I grill on my patio, and there is no mess when finished. The Master-Touch 22" cleans up nicely too. I wasn't sure if I would use the added warming rack system that came with the grill, but it is ideal for warming rolls and keeping the vegies hot while the burgers and dogs are getting happy. I enjoy the aroma of charcoal and apple, hickory, or mesquite. As much as I've used my gas grill, the Master-Touch adds a whole new dynamic to the dining adventure. I expect to have many years of enjoyment from this grill. It's well built, and all the parts were well packaged and in the box. Nothing was damaged, and the lid and bowl were both round and fit perfectly. As I'm writing this review, I'm thinking of my next grilling event; fish or tri-tips? So many choices.
Results.Title: Dynamic Dining Adventures

14501001.Name: 22” Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill
14501001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill. This grill features a handy Tuck-Away Lid Holder that gives you a convenient place to nest the lid against the side of the bowl, a hinged cooking grate that fits circular GBS accessories so you can explore more ways to cook, a built-in lid thermometer, and legs that are 2” taller than standard kettles. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retain heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results.
